title: Step-up transformer voltage
description: Essential: Correctly calculates U₂ = (n₂/n₁) × U₁ = 2000 V.

title: Transmission line current
description: Important: Correctly applies I₂ = P₂ / U₂ using the generator's output power and the stepped-up voltage.

title: Power loss calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates P_loss = I₂²R = 100 W.

title: Step-down input voltage
description: Important: Correctly determines U₃ by accounting for power loss (U₃ = (P₂ - P_loss) / I₂) or via voltage drop (U₃ = U₂ - I₂R).

title: Power conservation reasoning
description: Optional: Explicitly states that ideal transformers conserve power (P₁ = P₂, P₃ = P₄).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (kW, V, A, Ω, W) throughout the solution.

title: Incorrect power for I₂
description: Pitfall: Uses the generator's output power (10 kW) with the wrong voltage (e.g., 400V) to calculate transmission line current.

title: Neglecting power loss for U₃
description: Pitfall: Assumes U₃ = U₂, ignoring the voltage drop across the transmission line resistance.
